body:
> Having services already integrated would be great until certain time. I tend to agree on this with @vvo, as in long term it'd be pain to maintain.

Erf sorry for the misleading comment earlier. I agree with both of you :) The push function gives the ability to handle any service, and people who want to use it know what they are doing.

The timeout issue is not much about the 3 seconds but the image you get on the GA side. Do you want to have an idea of the kind of actions the user has taken before actually going to a product? I don't think the timeout brings much. It might never send any information before the actual trigger of beforeunload or click. Maybe the part that has the timeout is no even necessary. I'm wondering because I'm not a GA user :D
